_comment: Which benchmark modules cover each src/skimage/<subpackage>/. Used to scope a run to the subpackages a change touches: by CI in .github/scripts/resolve-benchmark-params.py, and locally by `spin asv --changed`. Subpackages absent here (color, data, draw, future, io) have no benchmarks, and benchmark_import_time covers the whole package rather than one subpackage, so neither scopes a run.
